newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, tin, zinc falls, aluminium steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, tin, zinc falls, aluminium steady.

text.p: Copper, tin and nickel prices extended losses on the metal market on Thursday, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady at the reduced level in a limited activity.
Copper fell further by 50 rupees to 13,650 rupees per quintal after losing 100 rupees on Wednesday as setback in the world market prompted unloading by the local stockists.
"Copper prices in the world market have fallen to a five-month low and Indian market is mirroring world trend," a broker said.
Tin fell further on weak trend in the world market while nickel lost fresh ground on increased supplies of Russian metal in the local market, dealers said.
Tin fell by 100 rupees at 29,100 rupees per quintal after losing 400 rupees on Wednesday while nickel fell by 100 rupees at 34,000 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Wednesday.
Aluminium was steady at 7,700 rupees so was zinc at 8,100 rupees and lead at 4,100 rupees per quintal in a limited activity. Zinc was down by 50 rupees and lead by 25 rupees per quintal on Wednesday.
Overall sentiment was subdued at the close amid virtual absence of physical enquiries. Trading volume was negligible.
